name: Night Out Planner
description: Create a date-aware night-out plan from a required occasion or preference. An explicit destination in the command wins; otherwise the workflow uses the active mode's JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION and then JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE. Weather, Google Local, Yelp, Tripadvisor, and Canvas provide a bounded plan without making reservations.

steps.description: Resolve the destination and get the available forecast window

params.query: restaurants, drinks, and dessert matching this night-out request: ${request}

steps.abort_speech: Night Out could not find local dining candidates for the resolved destination.
steps.description: Find dining and drinks that fit the request

params.query: evening activities and entertainment matching this night-out request: ${request}

params.find_desc: restaurants, bars, dessert, and nightlife matching ${request}

steps.description: Cross-check dining and nightlife with Yelp signals
Add destination-anchored Tripadvisor activity candidates without enrichment fan-out
Create the dated Canvas night-out plan

success_speech: Your night-out plan for ${planning_context.location} is ready in Canvas.
partial_speech: Your night-out plan for ${planning_context.location} is ready in Canvas using the local sources that were available.
abort_speech: Night Out could not be completed. Include an occasion or preference and optionally a destination, or configure a default location for the active mode.
